name: Glungezer
kurzbeschreibung: The Glungezer at 2,677 m above sea level near Tulfes: panoramic mountain in the Tux Alps with a 10-person gondola, Kugelwald (Ball Forest) on the Glungezer, and Zirbenweg (Stone Pine Path).
beschreibung:
Overview

The impressive Glungezer is a 2,677-meter-high mountain peak in the Tux Alps in Tyrol's Inntal valley, rising directly southeast of the traditional salt-mining town of Hall in Tirol in the holiday community of Tulfes. As the sun-drenched local mountain of the southern low mountain range, it forms a multifaceted excursion and nature paradise for families, leisurely hikers, and alpinists. From the summit ridge and the panoramic terraces, a breathtaking 360-degree view opens up over the entire Lower and Upper Inntal, the mighty Karwendel mountain range opposite, and the glaciated Zillertal and Stubai Alps.

Route & Requirements

Thanks to state-of-the-art mountain railway facilities – the 10-person gondola Glungezerbahn I and II – guests can comfortably reach the Tulfein mountain station at 2,055 meters above sea level in just about 15 minutes from Tulfes (922 m) via the Halsmarter middle station (1,560 m). At the Halsmarter middle station, families can experience a worldwide unique sensation: the Kugelwald (Ball Forest) on the Glungezer. On a natural area of over 7,000 m² in the shady mountain forest, the world's largest wooden ball run in the open air winds its way.

Visit & Arrival

The Glungezerbahn operates continuously during the summer season from the end of May to the end of October, daily from 08:30 to 17:00. Summer cable car prices (as of season 2025/2026): Ascent and descent to Tulfein mountain station adults approx. €28.50, seniors approx. €25.50, children (born 2009–2018) approx. €15.00; toddlers ride free. Admission to the Kugelwald on the Glungezer is included free of charge with the cable car ticket to the middle station (stone pine wooden balls can be purchased at the ticket office or from the ball vending machine for approx. €3.00). Holders of the regional Hall-Wattens Guest Card or the Freizeitticket Tirol receive discounts. Arrival by car: Via the Inntal motorway A12 (exit Hall Mitte), then on the L9 to Tulfes to the valley station of the Glungezerbahn (ample free parking available). By public transport: ÖBB to Hall in Tirol train station, from there the VVT bus line 4132 runs every half hour directly to the Tulfes Glungezerbahn stop.

Tips

The 10-person gondola, the panoramic restaurants at the Halsmarter and Tulfein stations, and the main paths in the Kugelwald are barrier-free and easily accessible with strollers and wheelchairs. Stop at the Alpengasthaus Halsmarter and enjoy traditional Tyrolean cheese dumplings or homemade Kaiserschmarrn on the sun terrace with a view of the Karwendel. In winter, the Glungezer also offers a popular family ski area until April and provides unforgettable impressions for your entire holiday in Tyrol.
preis: Mountain railway ascent and descent to Tulfein approx. €28.50; Kugelwald on the Glungezer free of charge
oeffnungszeiten: Summer season end of May to end of Oct daily 08:30–17:00 (cable car operation)
